name: Lantern Village
summary: A Grimm-inspired woodland hamlet of five colonists, slowly escalating from folklore dangers to supernatural horror as the forest presses in.

mods.name: Dark Ages: Beasts and Monsters
mods.notes: Source of folklore/supernatural threats for the escalation arc. Exact packageId/workshopId to be confirmed against the subscribed item before M2.

mods.name: Medieval Overhaul
mods.notes: Medieval technology restriction for the hamlet. packageId to be confirmed against the subscribed item.

mods.name: GloomyFurniture
mods.notes: Woodland-hamlet set dressing. packageId to be confirmed against the subscribed item.

mods.name: Realistic Darkness
mods.notes: Drives the slow folklore-to-horror escalation visually. packageId to be confirmed against the subscribed item.

mods.name: World Tech Level
mods.notes: Pins the wider world to medieval tech so trade/raids stay in-genre. packageId to be confirmed against the subscribed item.

desired.name: Lantern Village
desired.pitch: Five settlers carve a hamlet out of the deep wood. What begins as wolves and bad weather becomes something that watches from the treeline.

desired.backstoryTheme: woodcutters, a herbalist, a hedge-priest, a trapper, a village elder
desired.equipment: medieval hand tools and simple woodland weapons only; no firearms

desired.memeTheme: folk/animist precepts fitting a woodland hamlet that quietly fears the forest

desired.arc: Slow escalation: mundane folklore dangers (wolves, bandits, bad omens) in the early game, rising through uncanny events, to supernatural horror drawn from Dark Ages: Beasts and Monsters in the late game.
desired.pacing: escalation should be gradual across in-game months, not a hard milestone switch

implementation.notes: Campaign director/event escalation is M5 scope; not implemented in M1.
One-click start/resume is M4 scope. M1 only validates the manifest and can activate/restore the mod profile.

runtimeChecklist: workshop.ps1 env reports RimWorld, Steam, and .NET SDK found
workshop.ps1 validate lantern-village reports which required mods are missing from this machine
Subscribe to any mods workshop.ps1 reports missing, then re-run validate until it reports OK
workshop.ps1 activate lantern-village backs up the current ModsConfig.xml and writes a new one with exactly these mods
workshop.ps1 restore puts the previous ModsConfig.xml back and is confirmed byte-identical to the pre-activate file

notes: M1 validation fixture only. Mod packageIds above are best-effort guesses from mod names and must be confirmed against the actual Steam Workshop items before this experience is implemented (M2+).
